node.label: Fiscal policy & capex
node.summary: Union government spending, capital expenditure and fiscal discipline.

facts.text: Union Cabinet approved the **VISTAR** scheme (**Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics and Research**) with an outlay of **₹4,371 crore** (FY2026-27 to 2030-31) to overhaul India's statistical ecosystem, in three components including an economic census.

facts.text: FM **Nirmala Sitharaman**: public capex will continue until private investment picks up, but '**fiscal prudence is non-negotiable**' to protect credit ratings.
